newsitem.title: FRANCE: Car sales in France fall 21.7 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Car sales in France fall 21.7 pct in November.

text.p: New car sales in France fell 21.7 percent to 135,294 registrations in November from year-earlier levels, the French carmakers committee CCFA said on Monday.
PSA Peugeot Citroen car sales in France fell 27 percent in November while Renault SA sales fell 20.4 percent, it said in a statement.
In the first 11 months of 1996, car sales totalled 1.99 million units, up 11.2 percent from the year-earlier period.
French carmakers took 55 percent of the domestic market in November and had 56.1 percent for the 11-month period.
Totals may not add up because PSA or Renault figures do not include vehicles sold by niche producers or because of rounding.
